}

    t = time.parse(d.deployed_at)

}

    return c if acc == null else (c if c.t > acc.t else acc)
}

assert(owner.owner_email != null, "no owner email")

    recorded: res.recorded,
    service: suspect.service,
    deploy_sha: chosen.sha,
    owner_email: owner.owner_email,
    burst_start: time.format(burst_start),
    deploy_time: time.format(chosen.t),
    suspect_total_errors: suspect.total,
    totals: for f in firsts { return { service: f.service, total: f.total } }
}

Potential issue: the `compose` tool description says independent calls run concurrently; `owner` and `deploys` both depend only on suspect, run concurrently. pages fetch depends on suspect. Fine.
